svg.title: subarray product below threshold — anonymized whiteboard

g.text: Given an array of integers `nums` and an integer `k`, return _the number of contiguous subarrays where the
product of all the elements in the subarray is strictly less than_ `k`.
**Explanation:** The 8 subarrays that have product less than 100 are:
Note that [10, 5, 2] is not included as the product of 100 is not strictly less than k.
Use a sliding window to keep track of sub-array.
Since, it is greater than K, the window cannot be extend any more, because, on extension
the product will only increase (all numbers are >= 1).
product = 3 * 8 = 24; It is less than K, hence count the number of contiguous sub-arrays.
In the example above, they are [3] and [3, 8].
Note, the new product is computed based on last product (6 * 3 * 8) and dividing by the
number that just moved out of the window (6).
Product is larger than the target, keep decreasing the window by moving left end closer
to the right end, until either product is less than target or left and right are same.
